usage: As a noun, 打字 (daa2 zi6) refers to the act or process of typing.
As a verb, it means to type text using a keyboard or device.
You can use it in present continuous sentences, e.g. 'I am typing' – 我喺打字.
It can also be combined with other verbs to describe actions related to typing, like 'practicing typing' (練習打字).
It often appears in conversations about computers, smartphones, or any device used for inputting text.
